Through the car's own body and seat modules; seats move at any speed, Make room, easy exit and the steering column only standing.
manifest.title: Comfort

manifest.description: Plays and manages the Drive Recorder's clips for the Drive Recorder app: the picture through the GPU renderer, thumbnails, lock, delete, the oldest clips replaced at 4 GB, Copy to USB (the whole clip, or one camera as an MP4 with date, time and speed on it); on iDrive 7 and 8 it also starts the Drive Recorder app at every start of the car when its Start with the car is on (1.2.6)
manifest.title: Drive Recorder player

manifest.description: QuickSelect strip (iDrive 8.5 style) in the climate bar: four shortcuts (tap opens, hold 1 s saves the screen you are on, any of the head unit's own icons per shortcut), seat heating / ventilation in the HMI's own spots, steering wheel heating, M1 / M2 switch the M Mode; shift lights on the cluster for cars without their own (not M cars; with Cluster renderer 0.3.6 or newer). Set up in the Overlays app. Needs Renderer (mgu-render) 0.6.10 or newer.
manifest.title: Overlays

manifest.description: The centre display in a browser (http://<head unit>:5880/ over your tailnet, or an SSH -L tunnel), clicks and drags become touches. Auto-sizes to any panel (ID7/ID8)
manifest.title: Screen share

manifest.description: Remote access to the head unit over your tailnet (Tailscale in userspace networking, through the internet uplink)
manifest.title: Tailscale

manifest.description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with a turn card and, near each turn, a blue turn sign (three chevrons pointing the way), from BMW navigation, CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera alone without a route. Or on the head unit instead (0.9.0, the Turn View app's Camera page: Picture on Head unit), at any speed: the camera's whole picture with the same card and sign, a kerb-parking aid. iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: off at every start of the car; switch it on in the Turn View app and set Instrument cluster > Central display area to Map view; the camera takes the map area there. Not together with Waze on cluster on the cluster: set Waze on cluster to HUD only (the cluster and the HUD show 2 videos at most). Set up and calibrated in the Turn View app. Drawn by Cluster renderer (robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps) 0.5.10 or newer. No coding needed.
